plan.title: Fitness Programme Results
plan.subtitle: Summary of participant growth and performance by location and coach

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM "baseline" UNION ALL SELECT "Child ID" FROM "endline")

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups") AS n FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Avg Height Gain (cm)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Height cm" - b."Height cm") AS n FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Height cm" IS NOT NULL AND e."Height cm" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups by Location
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_situps FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run by Coach
panels.sql: SELECT "Coach", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_shuttle FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 5 Locations by Participation
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT "Location" FROM "baseline" UNION ALL SELECT "Location" FROM "endline") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
